## How we did on the April 2026 milestone ("Kick-off pre-trained 100B-A13B 1.2T token MoE (pregistered)")

The milestone was organized into two parent epics — Modeling [#4266](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4266) (split into MoE-scaling [#4281](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4281), Agentify [#4282](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4282), Increase-MFU [#4283](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4283)) and Infra [#4256](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4256) (split into [#4268](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4268)–[#4273](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4273)). Overall: most goals landed; a few were parked.

**Modeling.** MoE scaling [#4281](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4281) hit its headline: clean "best-recipe" isoflop **up to 1e22 completed** and **1e23 launched + pre-registered** (achieved); the 1e21 "Good/Great 10T" ablation row stayed unchecked. The 1e22 run [#3800](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/3800) (`moe-v7-1e22-d3200`, ~34.6B total/4.7B active, 326B tokens, **TPU** v4-512) achieved paloma macro_loss **2.432** / c4_en bpb **0.7423** (cf=4.0), within 0.003 of the L∞=1.0 scaling-law projection — though it cost a recurring checkpoint-resume XLA crash. MFU [#4283](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4283) targeted v4 25–30% and matching Megatron on **GPU** H100x8 (target/aspirational); the merged Triton `ragged_dot` kernel [#4297](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/pull/4297) gave **+8.8% achieved** end-to-end on H100x8 (5.55%→6.04% MFU). Agentify [#4282](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4282) closed as "morally done."

**Infra.** Off-Ray [#4269](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4269) achieved (zero `import ray` in lib/marin; only `marin-big-run` left for the 1e23 run). Reserved/on-demand capacity [#4268](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4268) and canonical pipelines [#4272](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4272) mostly landed; Usability/Observability [#4273](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4273) shipped (log-service split [#5212](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/5212)/[#5290](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/5290)/[#5370](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/5370)). Genuinely unresolved: the canary-90% target [#4270](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4270) (tracking/alerting unchecked) and marin-as-a-library [#4271](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/issues/4271) (demo repo only). Iris controller instability persisted through April–May.
